thesis: The episode explores the history of software and software investing, specifically using the story of MongoDB to illustrate how betting on faster development was a non-consensus view in 2012 that became consensus by 2019. The conversation details how MongoDB solved the problem of schema planning to allow developers to iterate quickly, eventually maturing into a scalable production database that challenged established players like Oracle.
